# testdata

Small, hand-made fixtures for unit tests. These files are committed; everything else
data-like (`*.ply`, `datasets/`, renders) is git-ignored.

Rules:

- Keep each file tiny (a few KB). A test fixture should hold a handful of Gaussians, not a scene.
- Write down how each file was made (by hand, or by which script) in the table below.
- Real trained scenes (e.g. the Mip-NeRF 360 *garden*) live outside the repo; see
  [docs/vertexnova/gs/learn/references.md](../docs/vertexnova/gs/learn/references.md) for downloads.
